question_text: Length of the stem at time 0 is $20\text{ cm}$. The arithmetic growth rate is $30\text{ cm per day}$. What is the length of the stem at the end of the $7^\text{th}$ day?
explanation:
In arithmetic growth, the length at time $t$ is given by the linear equation:
$$L_t = L_0 + rt$$
Here, initial length $L_0 = 20\text{ cm}$, growth rate $r = 30\text{ cm/day}$, and time $t = 7\text{ days}$.
$$L_7 = 20 + (30 \times 7) = 20 + 210 = 230\text{ cm}$$.
Hence, option (D) is correct.

question_text: The wavelength of light absorbed by $P_r$ form of phytochrome is
explanation:
Phytochrome exists in two interconvertible forms:
1. $P_r$ (inactive form) absorbs red light at $660-680\text{ nm}$ and is converted into the $P_{fr}$ form.
2. $P_{fr}$ (active form) absorbs far-red light at $730\text{ nm}$ and is converted back into $P_r$.
Hence, $680\text{ nm}$ is absorbed by the $P_r$ form.
